title: Deborah and Barak Defeat Sisera
summary: Deborah the prophetess and Barak defeat Sisera at the Kishon; Jael kills Sisera; "the land had rest forty years" (Judg 4–5).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1298 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: DEBORAH & BARAK "40 YRS": 1298 BC to 1258 BC; Jabin's 20 years (1298–1278 BC) inside the 40
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
chronologies.note: The victory falls at 1278 BC (end of Jabin's bar) on Jones's chart.

chronologies.date: 2719d AM, 1285 BC (Sisera defeated; land at rest 40 years)
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §351 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

chronologies.date: "2726 - Beginning of Barak's 40-year judgeship and peace in the North (Jud. 5:31)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. p. 46: "the end of Barak's peace in the North and the end of Ehud's peace in the Center almost certainly came at the same time, in the year 2766."

chronologies.date: "2700 - Death of Jabin, beginning of Barak's 40-year judgeship and peace in the North (Jud. 5:31)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 5:2: "Jabin was defeated by Barak and Deborah in 2700".

chronologies.date: 2726 AM 4th & 5th Judge: Barak and Deborah judged in the North 40 yrs. (5:31)
chronologies.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 8, chart "Year of the World: From the Judges to King Saul (Chronology from James Jordan)"
chronologies.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2726.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus, ch. 6 "The Special People of God", PDF p. 192 (printed p. 191)
chronologies.note: Judges table. Differs from the sort year (1298 BC, ussher-jones) by 18 years.
